column3: Need an absorbing P-position tail for every outer stack a, with no moves between tail P positions and a move into P from every excluded position. Finite recursion at bounded stack size cannot certify the infinite c tail or uniform existence of b0.

Source Conjecture5.4 itself leaves the permitted extra-vertex adjacencies qualitative. A finite lazy-cop attractor calculation could classify ten-vertex graphs but the exact target family and connectedness convention must first be fixed; supplying them is not a discovery.

Requires a polynomial transitive-subtournament guarantee for every forbidden tournament. Recursive homogeneous-set bounds of exponential square-root-log size do not supply a positive power. Correcting the printed delta(H) variable earns no credit.

Hook-length cancellation suggests bounding corner removal ratios, but one needs a high-probability bound uniform over every subpartition for each s and a single positive alpha. Typical shape convergence alone does not control extreme removable corners.

Need to prove that an extremizer for every sufficiently large n at each fixed local crossing bound has an uncrossed edge, not merely construct many edges. Retrieved v3 has changed presentation and no located literal target passage; reconcile original D_n and local-crossing conventions before proof work.

Source Conjecture3 and Theorem14 address rainbow matchings using extremal families. Known n>=sk+(s-1)(k-1) range is narrower than all n>sk; closing the near-threshold range requires global matching structure, not a small coloring example in the proved range.

Golden-parallelogram examples provide lower bounds only. Full maximality requires controlling denominators of all inside-out polytope vertices for arbitrary q; current-version source passage for literal Fibonacci formula not yet reconciled. Small-q numerator or indexing repairs are uncredited.

Frontal-queen vertex denominators require global determinant bounds for every attack arrangement, not just displayed Fibonacci constructions. Literal formula passage in the retained successor version is not yet reconciled; no exhaustive arrangement certificate is available.

Existing multiscale robber strategy gives exp(c log n/log log n) and lining-up cops give n. Near-linear n^(1-o(1)) at one fixed sufficiently large speed needs a much more efficient scale recursion; finite grids cannot certify the exponent.

Need n^(5/2) distinct pairs (vertex count,edge count) for every C-Ramsey graph. Anti-concentration must hold across many induced sizes and cannot follow just from the number of induced edge counts at one size; no small witness or uniform mechanism established.

Source successor discussion AK17 removes restrictions for the lower bound but gives only bipartite additive inner-product preservation for the improved upper bound. That does not preserve all pairwise distances relatively; full parameter-uniform upper bound is the remaining mechanism gap.

Monotone decreasing compatibility density only gives a nonnegative limit. Need the actual compatible-pair counting definition and denominator growth to force the limit to zero; printed six values cannot distinguish a positive limit. Definition and successor review remain incomplete.

Exact threshold needs bounded-order homomorphic targets above 1/(2ell-1) for every ell>=4 and sharp obstructions below. The stronger specific F_k^ell target is already reported false for even ell; that is not a refutation of arbitrary bounded-order targets.

Must bound both support size and every decomposition number for all finite groups of character defect two. Source handles p-solvable and selected quasi-simple groups but explicitly leaves nondefining-characteristic Lie type; defect-three counterexamples do not refute this scope.

Literal record defines H-good as r(T,H)=|T|+|H|-2, while primary uses (|T|-1)(chi(H)-1)+sigma(H). Trees versus K3 already contradict the record for large orders through standard Ramsey equality. Repairing the definition or reusing known Ramsey constructions is ineligible; intended all-H linear threshold is not settled here.

Primary rephrases rainbow matching as an independent set meeting every Vi, allowing the same edge to meet overlapping sets. Treating labels as distinct representatives manufactures a counterexample. Genuine scope needs a bipartite matching simultaneously meeting all large edge sets; source's degree+1 obstruction does not meet degree+2 threshold.

Need one matching meeting all partition quotas floor(|Ei|/(Delta+2)) simultaneously. Independent per-class matchings cannot be combined without conflicts; source proves related line-graph and small-number-of-class cases, not this full edge-partition claim.

Embedding an arbitrary infinite bounded-degree graph at a uniform positive upper density needs simultaneous control of all vertices, not just a monochromatic path or finite bounded-degree Ramsey embedding. Compactness does not preserve a quantitative density lower bound.

Finite tables cannot prove absence of rational non-CM eigenforms at all levels and all weights>=52. Requires an effective uniform arithmetic exclusion akin to generalized Maeda phenomena; a verified finite-level list would be an instance only.

Need reduce arbitrary matching number to matching-number-one examples without increasing tau/nu in all derived m-set hypergraphs. A disjoint union achieves existing g lower bounds but proves no upper reduction; already contains a generalized Tuza-type obstacle.

Requires connectedness at r=1 and disconnection for every larger admissible radius of the entire labeled configuration space. M6 move obstruction only limits that path, not all possible paths or all components; a 21-dimensional cell certification is far beyond a small witness.

Need joint simple spectrum of all divisor operators in every degree sector, with the correct coefficient field. Generic numerical eigenvalues at small m do not prove all-m simplicity or exclude parameter specializations; source Corollary7.8 is conditional and cannot be used circularly.

Cardinality monotonicity for arbitrary E and S does not follow by padding k-additive equations unless admissible zero arguments and f(0)=0 are available. Primary's multiplicative-function convention and meaning of determined must be reconciled before building an abstract countermodel; convention repairs earn no credit.

A symbolic generic Jacobian rank proof would certify each secant dimension, but arbitrary n,k requires an explicit nonzero minor family and matching upper bound up to ambient saturation. Source computations n<=15 and higher-moment examples do not settle this cubic family.

Restricting color sets to a subgraph can violate exact vertex-degree requirements even when cover inequalities persist. Source proves equivalence of monotonicity to tau=max(Delta,omega); existing edge-coloring upper bound alone leaves a possible extra color and no direct restriction certificate.

Primary Assumptions2 allow u0=0 and Theorem3 imposes no nonzero requirement. Linear semigroup sends zero to zero, so strict endpoint inequality becomes 0<0. This is a degenerate endpoint/domain defect, not substantive discovery; no repaired positive-data assertion is proved.

Need a uniform O(1/N) bound across both boundary intervals for all t including 0 with source A,C,u0 assumptions. Boundary drift suggests layers but differentiating twice introduces coefficient terms; neither maximum principle nor endpoint-only bounds directly give the stated rate.

Need two vertex sets each avoiding every maximum clique, equivalently a two-coloring with no monochromatic maximum clique. Ordinary proper coloring or chi-boundedness does not produce this property. Complete graph splitting is an instance; structural decomposition for all long-hole-free graphs is missing.

Need dimension-only positive scalar-curvature supremum gap without entropy or moduli constraints. Source quantitative gap depends on A,H and cannot discard them by compactness without noncollapse; flat-cone distance conjecture is separate.

Fifteen nonzero effective theta characteristics supply an upper bound, but every one must be realized by an ambient tropical tritangent plane for all curves. Source equality under algebraizability does not prove realizability without that hypothesis.

Exact balancing of clique sizes at fixed n,b could be approached by a one-vertex transfer inequality for the sum of inverse square-root transmission sums. The source n=13 exception shows naive convexity fails; uniform sign estimates and a verified finite initial range plus successor clearance are absent. No full-scope proof found.

Primary introduction explicitly reports existing counterexamples to reg<=Delta and cites hardness reg=Delta+1. Recreating a regular-edge-partition counterexample or formalizing it is already-covered public work; the referenced witness proof has not been audited here.

Need explicitly construct enough reductions of Dickson invariants for the entire k=n Hilbert-series contribution at m=n+1, proving independence and degree coverage. Single invariant reductions or low-n finite-field linear algebra do not certify every n,q.

Strict fractional-defect improvement must hold outside an infinite odd-cycle blowup family except finitely many connected 4-regular graphs. Finite optimization on sampled graphs cannot show finiteness; need a structural equality classification or a uniform reducible configuration.

Primary states goal is proof for all t and has Section2 Proof of Conjecture1. Thus the exact local-to-global tournament statement is already public, not a new result; source proof chain is not independently dependency-audited here.

Mode counting requires controlling all critical points of arbitrary covariance Gaussian mixtures and rigorously excluding extra maxima. A symmetric three-component planar family suggests a small counterexample search, but numerical stationary points or plotted six modes are not certificates; no exact seven-mode witness established.

Exact all-pairs distances and imbalance counts can test n,k,ell, but proving every n>n_k and sharp minimality needs uniform piecewise distance formulas. A finite BFS sweep cannot prove eventual failure for every ell or clear closest successors.

Need algebraic K0 and K1 control for all tensor powers of L(1,3), not a topological Kunneth substitution. Primary says k=1,2 known; arbitrary tensor powers require regular-supercoherence/excision inputs not supplied by one-factor computations.

Full unconditional short-generating-function length lower bound is not supplied by sparse support or number of monomials because rational summands cancel. Source Theorem1.2 proves it under #P not subset FP/poly; removing that assumption is a structural lower-bound program.

Need a constant fraction of vertices removable while preserving a minimum-k subgraph at one edge above threshold. Source gives n/log n saving; iterating it changes the edge surplus and cannot yield fixed epsilon_k without a new density-preserving invariant.

Degenerate-order greedy coloring does not maintain balanced color-class sizes at k near (Delta+d+1)/2. Source's K4-minor-free result covers a special class; extending its recoloring to every d-degenerate graph needs a global exchange argument.

Primary exact complete-multidigraph quasi-order domination conjecture is its main proved result. The broader non-complete multidigraph stable-set-union conjecture remains separate and cannot be substituted. Replaying bounded domination is public work.

Primary explicitly proves generalized Klove identity, with x=2 as a specialization. Rook-polynomial coefficient extraction or an exact low-d polynomial replay is a verification of a public identity and earns no discovery credit.

Need impossibility of finite-mean exploration with at most d scouts in every d>=3 under exact finite-state interaction protocol. Low-dimensional recurrence arguments do not simply extend because relative-walk transience changes; bounded protocol simulations cannot prove all protocols.

Normalized Reeb-volume minimization must be bounded below by reciprocal resolved Euler characteristic in all dimensions. Finite reflexive-polytope data or Abelian equality cases give no all-d inequality; normalization and resolution independence require a primary dependency audit before computations.

Primary Lemma2.1, Corollary2.3 and explicit complement-of-Petersen remark refute Hamid bound. Independently checking that ten-vertex graph needs six vertices for an independent transversal dominates is a public witness replay, not discovery.

Potential induction removes high-degree vertices or groups of leaves, but each step must preserve exact cubic n versus t budget. Source already gives a sharp construction, so reproducing it proves only optimality conditional on the missing upper bound; successor coverage not cleared.

Need a uniform in-order deletion bound g(k)sqrt(Delta), not bounded graph-order sqrt(n). Equalizing maximum degrees needs a simultaneous k-vertex degree adjustment while keeping surviving vertices below them; known k=2/3 arguments do not close every k.

The displayed average is exactly E|sum x_i epsilon_i|, suggesting the sharp p=1 Khintchine inequality with constant 1/sqrt(2). The two-coordinate equal vector saturates it. Original sharp-constant primary proof and closest successors have not been inspected, so no novelty or new-proof claim is made.

Root-cluster Boltzmann exponents do not automatically control the largest cluster in a triangulation conditioned on n faces. Need upper tails across all clusters and a lower event of polynomially correct maximal size; the filling heuristic lacks the required comparison estimates.
